cabin_categories.name: Deluxe Inside
cabin_categories.description: Standard comfortable interior staterooms situated along inner corridor runs across residential decks.

cabin_categories.name: Deluxe Ocean View
cabin_categories.description: Staterooms featuring a large rectangular panoramic ocean window with expansive sea views.

cabin_categories.name: Deluxe Balcony

cabin_categories.name: Premium Suite Aurea
cabin_categories.description: Spacious luxury suites featuring a separate sitting area, generous walk-in wardrobe, and large private balcony.

cabin_categories.name: MSC Yacht Club Maisonette Suite mit Whirlpool (YJD)
cabin_categories.description: Luxury two-story maisonettes. The lower level includes a dining/living room area, double sofa bed, bathroom with shower, and a large private balcony with its own private whirlpool. The upper mezzanine level hosts a master bedroom and a master bathroom with a bathtub.
features: Lower level living room with sofa bed & guest bathroom
Upper level master bedroom & master bath with tub

cabin_categories.name: Yacht Club Interior Suite
cabin_categories.description: Interior luxury suites situated forward within the exclusive MSC Yacht Club enclave.

cabin_categories.name: Yacht Club Deluxe Suite
cabin_categories.description: Standard luxury balcony suites within the MSC Yacht Club featuring 24-hour butler service, dedicated concierge, and bespoke Italian furnishings.

cabin_categories.name: Yacht Club Royal Suite
cabin_categories.description: The largest and most prestigious suites onboard. Features an expansive master living and dining room, walk-in wardrobe, and a massive 40 m² wrap-around private terrace with a private dining table and personal outdoor Jacuzzi.

cabin_categories.name: The Swarovski Crystal Cabin (Suite 16018)
cabin_categories.description: Developed in exclusive partnership with the Swarovski Group and De Jorio Design International. Located on Deck 16 forward-starboard in the MSC Yacht Club, this Deluxe Suite is adorned with approximately 700,000 genuine Swarovski crystals across in-room furniture (bedside tables, coffee table, sideboard), custom wall-mounted sconces, and interior artwork. Marked by a crystallized door number on the exterior corridor and priced identically to standard Yacht Club Deluxe Suites.
cabin_categories.source: MSC Cruises Official Release / Swarovski Collaboration Bulletin
